name: hubspot-data-pull-demo
description: A tiny, beginner-friendly Python demo for pulling contacts and their associated companies from the HubSpot CRM API (read-only). Prints a summary and writes a CSV.

paragraphs: A tiny, friendly example that connects to HubSpot, pulls your contacts and the companies each contact is linked to, prints a summary, and saves your data two ways: a contacts.csv you can open in Excel or Google Sheets, and a contacts.db database that grows a little with every run.

The core script, pullcontacts.py, only reads data — it never changes anything in your HubSpot account. The repo also includes a few optional bonus scripts (tickets instead of contacts, and one that writes) — see Bonus scripts: tickets below. Each one says clearly whether it reads or writes.
Who this is for: anyone — no coding experience required. If you're building with an AI assistant ("vibe coding"), this is a clean, safe starting point you can copy, run, and change.
features: Token — a long secret password that lets this script read your HubSpot
Scope — a permission switch inside HubSpot. "Read contacts" and "read
Terminal — the text window where you type commands (Terminal on a Mac,
Virtual environment (venv) — a private folder that holds this project's
CSV — a plain spreadsheet file. Excel and Google Sheets open it directly.
